info.name: PdfCraft integration
info.summary: Edit PDFs in your Nextcloud with the PdfCraft PDF workbench
info.description:
Open any PDF in Files with **Edit in PdfCraft** and work on it right in the browser: annotate and comment, fill and sign forms, organize, combine and split pages, redact, add bookmarks, page numbers and watermarks, and more.
- **Save** writes the PDF straight back to Nextcloud, which keeps the previous state as a file version. - **Save As** stores a copy in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a PDF in Files opens it in PdfCraft instead of the viewer.
PdfCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Documents go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [PdfCraft](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft) (formerly PrintCraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native PDF application. It embeds a build of PdfCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
